summary: Three no-commit exits collapse to one `undefined`, so the merge stage guesses the cause — an in-repo dock is told its dock is out of tree

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: the rewrite states which exit it took, and the merge stage's two no-commit lines name the cause that call reported — a queue whose fresh re-read no longer carries the shipped entry's file is never reported as an out-of-tree dock, and a relocated dock that just wrote the queue is never reported as a footprint already recorded; the sha field, the tip-claim report and the commit refusal are unchanged
tests: the pending-ledger rewrite states which no-commit exit it took
notes: Measured on the tree: the no-op exit (`src/pendingLedger.ts:632`) and the out-of-tree-dock exit (`:680`) answer the same `commitSha: undefined`, and `commitAttemptLedger` (`src/waveMerge.ts:1085`-`:1093`) keys both lines on it — `:1089` says "dock outside repo", `:1092` says "already recorded". The no-op-with-shipped-tags case is already driven at `tests/pendingLedger.test.ts:619`. Seams `src/waveMerge.ts` with two standing entries.
